status: native-resolution data adapter and pilot bundles implemented; new multi-person model and training not launched

user_requirements.prediction: all observable people in each crop
user_requirements.old_sparse_checkpoints: must not load bidirectional or OPSD checkpoints
user_requirements.new_training_initialization: official Wan pretrained backbone; fresh task adapters and multi-person heads, as previously stated

data.invalid_index_do_not_use: native_tile_index_v1 (incomplete; incorrectly assumed annotation end equals video end)
data.temporal_window: 81 frames at original 30 fps, fixed origin within clip
data.split_policy: official sequence-level train/val split; test not used to tune preprocessing
data.person_filter: at least one visible in-crop joint in a frame; no minimum height filter
data.loss_masks: out-of-crop/padded joints excluded; visible and occluded joints distinguishable
data.training_sampling_proposal: 90 percent positive crop windows, 10 percent empty crop windows; all windows retained in index
data.partial_people: retained with joint masks; overlap reduces cutting but does not guarantee every person fits entirely in a tile
data.calibration: crop intrinsics stored, no resizing; do not apply Dense normal sign flips
data.pilot: native_tile_pilot_v1: 5-track, 33-track and empty training clips, lossless RGB arrays and aligned targets

next_model_implementation.target_schema: JTA native 22 joints, 2D pixels normalized to crop and root-relative 3D meters
next_model_implementation.head: multi-person queries, per-frame presence and per-person joint coordinates with visibility
next_model_implementation.assignment: match a predicted slot to one labeled track across a clip; annotation IDs used for supervision only

capacity.overflow: explicit error, never truncate; test distribution not audited

next_model_implementation.intrinsics: carry crop intrinsics into geometry conditioning, not only label files
next_model_implementation.sanity_sequence: empty and low-count crop checks, single-clip overfit, crowded overfit, cross-sequence validation, full training
